mapper.select: SELECT sm.module_name AS moduleName, sh.handler_name AS handlerName, sp.id AS permitId, sp.permit_name AS permitName, sp.alias_name AS aliasName, sh.order_no AS orderNo, CASE WHEN srp.permit_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isChecked FROM sys_permit sp INNER JOIN sys_handler sh ON sp.handler_id = sh.id AND sh.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_module sm ON sh.module_id = sm.id AND sm.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_role_permit srp ON srp.permit_id = sp.id AND srp.role_id = #{roleId} AND srp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sp.is_deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(sh.alias_name, '.', sp.alias_name) FROM sys_role_user ru INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ru.role_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_role_permit rp ON rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_permit sp ON sp.id = rp.permit_id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_handler sh ON sh.id = sp.handler_id AND sh.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ru.user_id = #{userId} AND ru.is_deleted = 0 AND sh.alias_name IS NOT NULL AND sh.alias_name <> '' AND sp.alias_name IS NOT NULL AND sp.alias_name <> ''

SELECT DISTINCT ru.user_id FROM sys_role_user ru WHERE ru.is_deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_permit rp INNER JOIN sys_permit sp ON sp.id = rp.permit_id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_handler sh ON sh.id = sp.handler_id AND sh.is_deleted = 0 WHERE rp.role_id = ru.role_id AND rp.is_deleted = 0 AND sp.alias_name = #{actionAliasName} AND sh.alias_name = #{handlerAliasName})
